title: Native provider results can publish after the server identity or active workspace has changed
trigger: Start native summarizeWithAI, then edit the server token/URL in Settings before the response arrives. The source ID/text/version can remain unchanged, so the result from the previous identity is saved. More seriously, a pending live-call status result can arrive after a pull replaces the workspace with a snapshot containing the same booking ID.
smallest_fix: Reuse the connection-generation guard and a workspace replacement generation in all provider mutation methods; preserve allowed unrelated edits via existing field/signature guards. Treat stale success and stale error paths consistently. Preserve the already-submitted call receipt and require polling under the original owner.
regression_check: Controlled ProviderClient double suspends summary/status, changes connectionToken or replaces snapshot while suspended, then returns old response; assert no old summary/transcript/status/notices are written. Repeat switch-away-and-back. Separate unchanged-identity control must still save.
dependency_and_coordination: A owns shared AppStore integration. Land connection guards before adjacent startup/order edits; preserve source/version protections.
